feeds.title: Regina Cat Rescue Blog
feeds.description: Regina Cat Rescue (RCR) is a non-profit, volunteer-run organization and registered charity that helps abandoned cats and kittens and educates people about the humane treatment of pets.

feeds.title: North Toronto Cat Rescue Blog
feeds.description: North Toronto Cat Rescue (NTCR) is a volunteer-run, non-profit, registered charity, genuinely concerned with the welfare of cats. We rescue and provide veterinary care to homeless cats and kittens, and follow through to recovery and finally adoption.

feeds.title: Ontario SPCA and Humane Society » Cat Care
feeds.description: Articles on Cat Care. The Ontario SPCA and Humane Society is a registered charity, established in 1873. The Society and its network of communities facilitate and provide for province-wide leadership on matters relating to the prevention of cruelty to animals and the promotion of animal well-being.

feeds.title: Cat Whisperer
feeds.description: I live in Quebec, Canada and my passions above all else are cats, gardens, fine wine, and True Blue.

feeds.title: Homes Alive Pets » Cat
feeds.description: Cats are independent and aloof, making it difficult to spot cat anxiety. Find out how to manage common signs of stress to keep your cat safe and happy. The Homes Alive Pets blog offers information, tips, and techniques for bettering your pet's health and being a more informed and educated pet parent.

feeds.title: Cat Lovers Only
feeds.description: My name is Kurt, and I am the publisher of Cat Lovers Only. Stay up to date with what's going on with all the cat lovers around here.

feeds.title: Ninth Life Cat Rescue
feeds.description: Ninth Life Cat Rescue is a Registered Canadian Charity that is entirely volunteer-driven. We are passionate and dedicated to rescuing cats from many different situations. Rescued cats are provided health care, food, a safe and warm foster home while they recover, and socialization to prepare them for adoption into forever homes.

feeds.title: Purr and Roar
feeds.description: All things cat related, the personal stories and experiences, what others are saying or doing, the fascinating, fun, educational, inspirational and the more serious stuff.

feeds.title: Just Cats
feeds.description: I am Deb. I have enjoyed providing a cat-sitting service in our town and surrounding areas for the last twenty years. Posts for cat lovers - cute pics of cats, feline news, cat tales, and everything cats!

feeds.title: Catoro Cafe
feeds.description: Latest updates on available cats, special offers, and more! We're a Vancouver based pet shop and cat cafe housing adoptable rescue cats.

feeds.title: thejoyofcats Blog
feeds.description: This blog intends to share the joy that cats bring to everyone in their world. Let's admit it, we all live in their world not the other way around.

feeds.title: Annex Cat Rescue
feeds.description: Annex Cat Rescue is a Toronto-based, 100% volunteer registered charity founded in 1997. Its mission is to address the problem of homeless cats in Toronto by spaying/neutering, bringing adoptable cats into our foster/adoption program, managing colonies of feral cats, and educating the public about responsible pet ownership and living with the community cats.

feeds.title: Toronto Cat Rescue Blog
feeds.description: Toronto Cat Rescue is a registered, no-kill charity driven by volunteers. Our mission is to rescue and find homes for abandoned, sick, or injured cats from situations of abuse, neglect, or imminent euthanasia.

feeds.title: Guelph Cat Clinic Blog
feeds.description: Check with us for fun cat facts and health information. We are a veterinary clinic located in downtown Guelph ON that is focused completely on cats.

feeds.title: Feline Rescue Foundation of Alberta Blog
feeds.description: Feline Rescue Foundation of Alberta ('FRFA') is a registered charity based in Calgary that provides rescue, rehabilitation, re-homing and sanctuary for cats living on city streets and rural areas. We are a NO-KILL organization.
